about: Which words the bar under a line just edited offers for the Dictionary (T12.15f): each white-space token of `after` whose word is not the core of a token of `before`, leaving out common words, words on `listed` (case ignored) and repeats in another case, in line order. crates/earshot-runtime (vocabulary_tests.rs) runs every case through `vocabulary::words_to_offer`, and packages/ui/src/ipc/mockWords.test.ts through the mock's `wordsToOffer`. The mock carries a short stand-in for the matcher's common words, so every common word here is in both lists. Every word is invented.
